senses.gloss: f. (כְּבַב, cmp. כּוּב) a little globe.
units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 24a:8">R. Hash. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>כ׳ דעיבא וכ׳</he> ed. (Ms. M. 1 <cite ref="K00251"><he>כּוֹכְבִיתָא</he></cite>, Ms. M. 2 a. Ar. <cite ref="K00255"><he>כוכיתא</he></cite>) they saw merely a globe-shaped cloudlet (which, they thought, was the moon).
